# PdfRenderResult

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Contains all rendered pages and the resources collected during layout.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new PdfRenderResult(renderContext: RenderContext, orientedPageSize: PdfSize)
```

## Properties

- [`orientedPageSize`](#orientedpagesize): The page size after orientation was applied.
- [`pageContentStreams`](#pagecontentstreams): The content stream of each page.
- [`pageDimensions`](#pagedimensions): The size and margin of each page, keyed by page index.
- [`renderContext`](#rendercontext): The context the document was rendered with.
